_comment: magistrate.json - what the Magistrate at the Lumora courthouse says (Scripts/magistrate_npc.gd on a talking_vendor.tscn; crime.gd). Same shape as soul_binder.json: greeting (when you hail and owe nothing), ambient/secret (said nearby every few minutes; secret only at night), topics (keywords said near them). A topic whose 'then' has hail: true opens the bounty / amends offer.
greeting: Nothing on your record. Keep it that way.
The law of Lumora is simple. Don't make it complicated.
Business? No? Then good day to you.
ambient: Fines are paid here, not argued. Next.
A bounty doesn't go away because you leave town. The guards remember faces.
Strike a citizen in these streets and you'll answer to the Wardens. Or to me, if you're lucky.
secret: Half the fines in this ledger were paid by people who swore they were innocent. A quarter of them were.
The Sandveil pay their fines in advance, some say. I couldn't possibly comment.

lines: Amends, is it? Let me see what the city holds against you.
